details: Trojanized update of hexo-deployer-wrangler. Version 1.0.3 was a legitimate Hexo deployer plugin (~4KB) wrapping the Cloudflare Wrangler CLI. Version 1.0.4 replaces index.js entirely with 5.2MB of heavily obfuscated JavaScript code using a ROT-character decoder and eval(), executing a hidden payload on require(). The benign first version established trust, then the malicious payload was pushed in a later update. The size, structure, and delivery mechanism of the obfuscated payload are consistent with credential harvesting or remote access payloads.
